frozen_device_view.rgb_transform: source RGB -> PIL bilinear 512x288 RGB PNG
frozen_device_view.oracle_transform: SANPO native -> frozen canonical 256x256 -> legacy IDs [0,1,2,3] to RISKSEG IDs [0,2,1,3]

arms.B_LEARNED_SEGMENTATION_ONLY: one seed's full-integer PIDNet-S mask only

shared_execution.reset: each arm resets once at each parent-event start
shared_execution.taxonomy_binding_rationale: The new four-class head requires an isolated ID-to-existing-risk-vocabulary interface. It adds no class, threshold, component rule, sampler, temporal gate, or event exception and is locked before any event outcome is opened.

parent_event_scoring.positive_event_hit: at least one delivered feedback alert inside the frozen alertable interval
parent_event_scoring.critical_miss: positive parent event with no delivered feedback alert inside the frozen alertable interval
parent_event_scoring.false_alert_event: negative parent event with at least one delivered feedback alert anywhere in its frozen window
parent_event_scoring.passed_cleared: positive parent event with zero delivered feedback alerts inside the frozen passed interval
parent_event_scoring.first_valid_reminder_frame: first delivered feedback alert inside the frozen alertable interval
parent_event_scoring.runtime_exited_by_passed_end: separate diagnostic; not substituted for the frozen clearance gate

quality_gates_per_seed.recall: learned minus YOLO >= 0.15 absolute and learned hits at least 3 additional parent events
quality_gates_per_seed.critical_miss: learned reduces at least 2 misses and neither positive bucket increases
quality_gates_per_seed.clearance: learned cleared event count and clearance rate >= YOLO
quality_gates_per_seed.timing_if_common_hits_at_least_4: median learned-minus-YOLO first-alert delay <= 1 frame and delay > 2 frame rate <= 0.25

stability_gate.rule: decision seed passes every quality gate; at least 2/3 seeds pass every quality gate; all seeds satisfy false-alert and clearance guardrails

trained_device_gate.model_cache_key: derived from exact trained TFLite SHA-256 to prevent preflight-context reuse

pre_output_lock_amendment.change: The trained final QNN timing runner now uses the same predeclared generic obstacle and curb vocabulary binding as the three-arm runner.
pre_output_lock_amendment.reason: The technical-preflight-only placeholder labels were not accepted by the frozen RiskAnalyzer. Aligning the final timing runner before event access makes its adapter and decision-chain work identical to the already locked quality runner; no threshold, gate, model, data, or scoring rule changed.
